name: party-of-two
description: An agent-native tabletop game whose companion's abilities are WebMCP tools, registered and unregistered from world state.

scripts.build: npm run check && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.check: node --experimental-strip-types src/game/sheet.check.ts && node --experimental-strip-types src/game/tools.check.ts && node --experimental-strip-types src/agent/repair.check.ts
